description_en: Checks the connectivity of a data source on a specified schedule resource group. Available since version 6.3.2
description_zh: 在指定调度资源组上检查数据源连通性，上线版本：v6.3.2
name: CheckDataSourceConnectivityOnResourceGroup

fields.help_en: The key of the configuration item
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The connection configuration items. If DataSourceId is specified, this parameter is optional and the saved configurations of the data source are used by default
fields.help_zh: 连接配置项；传 DataSourceId 时可不传，默认使用该数据源已保存的配置
fields.name: config_item_list

fields.help_en: The data source ID. This parameter is optional. If specified, the check result is associated with the data source and visible on the data source page, and the old check records of the data source on the target resource group are cleared first. If Type and ConfigItemList are not specified, the saved type and configurations of the data source are used for the check
fields.help_zh: 数据源ID（可选）：传入后本次检查结果将关联到该数据源（数据源页可见），并先清理该数据源在目标资源组上的旧检查记录；未传 Type/ConfigItemList 时使用该数据源已保存的类型与配置进行检查
fields.name: data_source_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the schedule resource group. The connectivity check task is executed on this resource group
fields.help_zh: 调度资源组ID，连通性检查任务将在该资源组上执行
fields.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The data source type. If DataSourceId is specified, this parameter is optional and the saved type of the data source is used by default
fields.help_zh: 数据源类型；传 DataSourceId 时可不传，默认使用该数据源已保存的类型
fields.name: type

Code.description_en: The error code of the request. A value of OK indicates that the request is normal
Code.description_zh: 请求错误码, OK表示请求正常
Code.title_en: 请求错误码, OK表示请求正常
Code.title_zh: 请求错误码, OK表示请求正常

Data.description_en: The ID of the connectivity check task. You can poll the task result by calling GetCheckConnectivityJobByJobId
Data.description_zh: 连通性检查任务ID，通过 GetCheckConnectivityJobByJobId 轮询任务结果
Data.title_en: 连通性检查任务ID，通过 GetCheckConnectivityJobByJobId 轮询任务结果
Data.title_zh: 连通性检查任务ID，通过 GetCheckConnectivityJobByJobId 轮询任务结果

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code returned by the backend

Message.description_en: The error message of the request

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
